name: NIRF Innovation parameters 2025
detail: FSI 0.25, IA 0.15, RIO 0.30, PII 0.10, AIE 0.10, Perception 0.10. Weights changed from 2024.
relevance: Sets the scoring surface StartupHub's reporting output must satisfy.

name: NIRF FSI startup sub-metric
detail: SU = 20 x f(N_vsp), N_vsp = DPIIT-recognised startups in previous 3 years. 5 marks of the final Innovation score hinge on one countable.
relevance: The single most quantified institutional incentive in the mandated stack.

name: ARIIA DCS cross-portal fetch
detail: ARIIA fetches from IIC, NISP, YUKTI and Innovation Ambassador portals, reducing submission effort by checking redundancy. One-directional, ARIIA-scoped only.
relevance: The only existing cross-portal de-duplication, and the template for what StartupHub generalises.

name: Factly/Dataful NIRF startup dataset
detail: 6,817 rows, 204 institutions, 5,490 distinct ventures, 4,538 registration numbers, 26 states, 80 cities, 2024-2026. Monetised from public DCS PDFs.
relevance: Proves institution-submitted innovation data is already public and already packaged by a third party.

name: State Startup Ranking (SRF) 5.0
detail: Results announced 16 Jan 2026; 34 States/UTs participated; 19 Action Points, 6 Reform Areas. Best Performer Cat A = Gujarat.
relevance: State-level pressure that propagates down to HEI reporting expectations.

name: Maharashtra Startup Policy 2025
detail: Commits to an online system mapping startups, incubators, accelerators, innovation labs, investors and mentors under a unique ID.
relevance: A state building the registry StartupHub would sit under - both a channel and a competitive risk.

name: NIDHI-PRAYAS 2.0 NOC requirement
detail: Students/faculty must submit an NOC confirming IP vests entirely with the innovator or startup.
relevance: An IP-vesting requirement with no portal to enforce it - StartupHub's IPR docket (D2) is the enforcement point.

name: MeitY Startup Hub IP due diligence
detail: Mandates TRL benchmarking and IP due diligence: ownership clarity, freedom to operate, defensibility. Distinguishes ownership vs a 2-year university tech-transfer licence.
relevance: The most explicit institutional statement that TRL and IP must be joined - StartupHub D1 + D2.

name: BHASKAR ID
detail: DPIIT launched BHASKAR (Bharat Startup Knowledge Access Registry) 16 Sep 2024, issuing an ecosystem-universal BHASKAR ID.
relevance: A national identity layer StartupHub must key to, not duplicate.

name: National Startup Master Data (planned)
detail: DPIIT plans to overhaul BHASKAR into a National Startup Master Data registry tracking the startup lifecycle. MeitY Startup Hub floated a similar tender.
relevance: The largest structural risk and the largest channel opportunity in the segment.

name: MAARG national mentorship platform
detail: AI matchmaking, session scheduling, cohort programmes and dashboards.
relevance: Mandated mentorship surface; StartupHub must integrate, not compete.

name: Kerala Startup Mission scale
detail: 375+ IEDCs across colleges and universities, 27 R&D institutions, 63 incubators; issues a KSUM UID as a third identity layer.
relevance: The densest documented state ecosystem and a model for how far a UID layer can reach.
